protocol.rgb: Pillow convert(RGB); no ICC transform; alpha discarded, not composited
protocol.pixel_sha256: SHA256(b'RGB\0' + big-endian uint64 width,height + RGB pixel bytes)
protocol.phash64: RGB->Pillow L; LANCZOS 32x32; OpenCV float32 orthonormal DCT; top-left 8x8; greater than median of all 64 including DC; row-major MSB first
protocol.dhash64: RGB->Pillow L; LANCZOS 9x8; right pixel greater than left; row-major MSB first

scope: 175101 project train cache +655 frozen sources; not all SAMTok pixels or arbitrary crops / same-scene frames.
